comparison.objective: Commission an industrial damper vs fit a grip sleeve onto a spoon.
comparison.physical_skill: Precision tool engagement, bounded torque, fine rotary adjustment, and test-feedback iteration vs bimanual hold-and-thread insertion along a handle.
comparison.success_condition: Two safe, repeatable stops without drift vs at least 8 cm covered length, assembly released on the table, grippers more than 10 cm away.
comparison.reason: The sleeve task tests coaxial threading and release; it lacks adjustable locking and measured dynamic-response tuning.
